measurement.clock: Node performance.now(), shared across document navigations
measurement.start: Immediately before Playwright mouse.click dispatch; protocol overhead included
measurement.end: Nonempty canvas in viewport, visible and >=99% opaque, fonts loaded, two stable rendering intervals; Node receives the probe report
measurement.evidence: First sample viewport screenshot is captured after the measured endpoint
measurement.comparability: Do not compare directly with older in-page .click()/performance.now() profiles, including the 611ms/366ms results

conditions.context: Fresh browser context and empty local storage per sample
conditions.landing: DOMContentLoaded, document.fonts.ready, CTA hover, then 250ms intent
conditions.hydration: No React-internal hydration check; native full navigation is allowed
conditions.server: Already warmed by integration and capture runs; one explicit unmeasured create immediately before profiling; no concurrent automated browser runner
conditions.instrumentation: Injected main-document DOM/resource probe; CDP trace on first sample
conditions.resources: All completed resource timings per main document, including landing/intent traffic; start times are document-relative
